scope: Only the independent Linux supervision helper and tiny, invented Python executable stubs. Standard library only. No policy, game, historical source, evaluator, measurement fixture, observation, or driver imports/calls.

finite_cases.case: A no-op stub exits zero; report process status and monotonic/CPU accounting without claiming evaluator returns.
A stub exits nonzero and another kills itself; preserve explicit exit code or signal and output prefix.
An inactive sleeping stub exceeds a reduced whole-cell wall budget; independently terminate and reap it.
An active sleeping stub atomically marks a call then suppresses profile installation; reduced per-call wall limit still terminates it.
An active CPU-spinning stub exceeds a reduced per-call CPU budget while unreaped; observe current /proc CPU and terminate it.
An inactive CPU-spinning stub exceeds reduced whole-cell CPU budget, independently of call-state hooks.
A phase wall budget already expired before spawn blocks execution; a running phase deadline kills its process group.
A phase CPU budget includes parent CPU, previous reaped children, and current live child CPU; stub-only mocks and bounded spin cover each term.
A stub forks a TERM-ignoring descendant; failure uses KILL as needed and verifies no owned descendant remains, including an escaped process group.
A stub exits leaving a descendant; reject success, clean and reap the descendant, and report cleanup evidence.

A stub reports RLIMIT_AS; assert exact requested frozen 512 MiB soft and hard limits. Mock unexpected inherited limits to block before spawn. Compare every resource-limit value with an explicitly supplied read-only admission snapshot.
Unavailable /proc process accounting or Linux subreaper support blocks before spawn; do not silently fall back to reaped-child-only accounting.

A stub emits more than a tiny helper-test output budget; preserve exactly the bounded byte prefix, report resource overflow, and terminate/reap the group. Exercise shared-budget callback denial and a context-manager guard held throughout log writes; a raised declared budget exception is resource-incomplete. Output is bounded in parent memory during child execution, then only the fitting observed raw-byte prefix is persisted after group cleanup; record any gap explicitly.
Missing inactive call-state is allowed before evaluator scope; malformed, oversized, nonfinite, future-clock, symlink, or changing active-scope state fails closed.
Atomic active-to-inactive state transition retains valid deadline semantics. Output/call-state pre-existence, symlinks, invalid limits and concurrent parent children block before spawn.
Injected state-read, proc-read, log-write, spawn and cleanup errors preserve evidence, stop owned processes, and report explicit failure without fabricated scientific output.

allowed_execution_when_separately_approv: Run only this fixed finite stdlib unittest suite after parent approval. Reduced limits are pure helper-test parameters; measurement driver must pass the exact frozen 360/720/1800 second and 512 MiB limits explicitly. No policy-bearing preflight or calibration is authorized.
